gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold states patient presents with anxiety symptoms. Generated chief complaint describes several months of anxiety, worse in mornings, with difficulty leaving the house and palpitations. Duration and specific features (morning-worse, difficulty leaving house, palpitations) are not in Gold, and Gold duration is 2 months, not several months, so this is not a clean match to simple anxiety symptoms.

Gold: 2-month history of feeling anxious all the time. Generated hpi-001 has 2-month history of progressive anxiety but not ‘all the time,’ and specifies fashion retailer head office; also head-office detail not in Gold. The core 2‑month continuous anxiety is not exactly captured (progressive vs continuously present), so not strictly covered.

Gold: anxiety began after starting a new job in a different industry with pressure from boss. Generated hpi-001: began after starting a new job in head office of a fashion retailer; generated sh-003: stressful work environment with an unkind boss. Together they capture new job and boss-related pressure; ‘different industry’ is omitted but the causal/new job link and boss pressure are present.

Gold: dreads going to work every morning. Generated hpi-002: daily morning dread about going to work and difficulty getting out of bed. This directly captures the dread about going to work every morning.

Gold: severe initial insomnia taking about 3 hours to fall asleep. Generated hpi-005: prolonged sleep latency and shallow sleep; bed at 22:00–23:00 with ~3–4 hours/night. Although 3-hour latency isn’t numerically repeated, prolonged latency plus low total sleep clearly reflects initial insomnia.
Gold: early-morning waking. Generated hpi-006: wakes before the alarm with racing heart and palpitations. This is consistent with early-morning waking.
Gold: often has only 3–4 hours sleep. Generated hpi-005: estimates ~3–4 hours/night. Directly matches.

Gold: patient feels tired during the day. Generated facts mention low energy (ROS-004) but no explicit daytime tiredness/fatigue. Low energy is not clearly tied to daytime tiredness in the generated text.
Gold: patient reports low energy. Generated ros-004: ROS positive for low energy. Directly matches.
Gold: eating pattern normal but more chocolate. No generated fact mentions eating pattern or chocolate.

Gold: anhedonia at work and outside; still sees friends but often avoids; previously enjoyed running, tennis, socialising. Generated hpi-004: patient avoids social activities (no mention that she still sometimes socializes), and hpi-008: reduced enjoyment of running and tennis (no mention of socialising or still seeing friends). Anhedonia and avoidance are captured, but the nuance that she still sees friends yet often avoids is missing, and ‘work’ context is not explicit.

Gold: palpitations began with anxiety symptoms. Generated hpi-006: palpitations on waking with morning anxiety; ros-002: panic-like palpitations associated with anxiety. This associates palpitations temporally with anxiety onset.

Gold: palpitations feel irregular and are accompanied by chest discomfort. Generated hpi-006: irregular palpitations; ros-010: ROS negative for sustained chest pain, but no explicit mention of any chest discomfort. Irregular palpitations are covered, the associated chest discomfort is omitted.

Gold: rapid palpitations lasting approximately 2–10 minutes. Generated hpi-006: racing heart and palpitations lasting a couple of minutes up to ~10 minutes. This matches onset, character (racing), and duration.
Gold: has not missed work despite symptoms. Generated hpi-009: has not missed work but frequently contemplates calling in sick. The fact of not missing work is clearly captured.
Gold: public transport is another trigger provoking anxiety. No generated fact mentions public transport or that as a trigger.

Gold: low mood most of the time. Generated ros-005: ROS positive for low mood. This captures presence of low mood, though ‘most of the time’ chronicity is not specified; still, low mood is clearly documented.

Gold: no past psychiatric history or significant anxiety. Generated hpi-007: no prior similar episodes, which is not the same as no past psych history or significant anxiety; it could refer only to similar palpitations/anxiety episodes. PMH detail is not explicitly reproduced.
Gold: mother has history of depression. Generated fh-001 states the same.
Gold: lives with supportive parents. Generated sh-001: lives with her parents, and sh-007: good family support. Combined, this matches living with supportive parents.

Gold: drinks Fridays and Saturdays, sometimes overdoes it. Generated sh-004: increased use on Fridays/Saturdays and occasional glass during the week; quantity not specified. Weekend drinking is captured; detail about ‘sometimes overdoes it’ is approximated by ‘increased use’ but the explicit ‘sometimes overdoes it’ nuance is not clearly repeated.
Gold: smokes occasionally. Generated sh-005: patient is an occasional smoker; ros-008: ROS positive for occasional smoking. This is clearly covered.
Gold: no illicit drugs. Generated sh-006: no illicit drug use; ros-011: ROS negative for drug use. Directly matches.
Gold: work-related anxiety. Generated asm-001: most likely anxiety disorder related to starting a new job. This is work-related anxiety.
Gold: insomnia. Generated asm-003: insomnia, thought secondary to anxiety; ros-003 also notes insomnia. The diagnosis of insomnia is captured.
Gold: advised self-referral to NHS talking therapies. Generated plan-001: recommend self-referral to NHS talking therapies. Direct match.
Gold: advised access to online CBT resources. Generated plan-003: provide online resources for anxiety while awaiting therapy. This aligns with online CBT resources.

Gold: blood tests as initial investigation specifically for palpitations, to be booked via support team. Generated plan-007: arrange basic blood tests to exclude contributory causes; plan-008: consider further cardiac evaluation. The purpose (investigate palpitations) is implicit but not named; booking via support team is omitted. Investigation by blood tests is covered, logistics are not.

Gold: contact clinic for further discussion if anxiety/mood worse or unable to cope with work. Generated plan-006: contact GP/support line if anxiety worsens or unable to cope with work/daily activities. This captures the instruction, with additional mention of daily activities.
Gold: patient reports no panic attacks. Generated ros-002 mentions panic-like palpitations but does not explicitly state absence of panic attacks. There is no explicit ‘no panic attacks’ statement.
Gold: denies suicidal ideation. Generated hpi-010 and ros-012 both state denial of suicidal ideation. Clearly covered.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold chief complaint is simply anxiety symptoms. Generated adds several months duration (conflicts with Gold 2 months), morning-worse pattern, difficulty leaving house, and palpitations. These details are not in Gold and partly inconsistent in duration, so overall this is not supported by Gold.

Supported: 2-month history of anxiety beginning after starting a new job (matches Gold hpi-001 and hpi-002). Additions: ‘progressive’ (vs feeling anxious all the time) and job being at a fashion retailer head office, which are not in Gold. Not a contradiction, but includes extra unsupported job details and slightly different descriptor of course.
Daily morning dread about going to work matches Gold hpi-003 (dreads work every morning). Added difficulty getting out of bed is extra but consistent.
Frequent worry about work performance is not explicitly described in any Gold fact. Gold indicates work-related anxiety and pressure from boss but not specific performance worry.

Gold describes anhedonia at work and outside, avoidance of running, tennis, and some socialising. Generated states patient avoids social activities. This is consistent with avoidance but omits the nuance that she still sees friends and often avoids; no contradiction, partial reflection of Gold.

Sleep disturbed with prolonged latency and only ~3–4 hours/night matches Gold initial insomnia (3 hours to fall asleep) and often 3–4 hrs sleep (hpi-006). ‘Shallow’ sleep is a reasonable descriptive addition.

Waking before the alarm with racing, irregular palpitations lasting a couple of minutes to 10 minutes aligns with Gold early-morning waking (hpi-005), rapid irregular palpitations 2–10 min (hpi-012, hpi-013). The linkage to waking is consistent. All components are supported by various Gold HPI elements.

‘No prior similar episodes reported’ is not stated in the Gold facts. Gold only says nil past psych history/significant anxiety and no panic attacks; that is not identical to no prior similar episodes of current symptom complex. This is additional.

Gold: anhedonia including previously enjoyed running and tennis, now often avoids. Generated: anxiety has reduced enjoyment of running and tennis. Directly supported, with slightly less detail about socialising.

Gold: has not missed work. Generated: has not missed work but contemplates calling in sick. The ‘not missed work’ portion is supported; contemplating calling in sick is an added detail not present in Gold.

Matches Gold family history of maternal depression.

No drug use aligns with no illicit drugs in Gold.
